title: Unni Krishnan, J.P. v. State of Andhra Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Unni Krishnan, J.P. v. State of Andhra Pradesh, (1993) 1 SCC 645
content.holding: The Court used Part IV principles in developing the constitutional understanding of education under Article 21, preceding the later insertion of Article 21A.
content.relevance: Illustrates integrated interpretation of Parts III and IV.
